(1) convergence implies stability of manifold-valued linear and nonlinear subdivision schemes and (2) convergence of a linear subdivision scheme implies stability of the associated nonlinear multiscale transforms.

the stability of a nonlinear subdivision operator and its associated multiscale transformation can be proved if the nonlinear operator is close to a linear one, and if this linear operator is stable and has a convergent multiscale transform.

the stability of nonlinear multiscale transformations is equivalent to a certain type of proximity condition and that this proximity condition is satisfied for manifold-valued nonlinear subdivision schemes.
